hero.subline: Designing and engineering Rwanda's future, one landmark at a time.

story.heading: Built From the Ground Up

paragraphs.text: SAGEC Ltd was founded with a singular vision — to deliver world-class architectural and engineering solutions that elevate Rwanda’s built environment. From our earliest projects in Kigali, we built a reputation for precision, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to quality.

Over the years, we have grown from a focused architectural practice into a full-service firm spanning structural engineering, MEP systems, project management, construction management, and interior design. Each discipline strengthened by the last — and every project a stepping stone to the next.

Today, SAGEC stands behind some of Kigali’s most recognisable landmarks. But for us, the most important structure is always the next one — and the trust our clients place in us to bring their vision to life.

story.quote: We don’t just build structures. We build trust, one project at a time.

mission.text: To deliver innovative, sustainable, and high-quality architectural and engineering solutions that transform Rwanda’s built environment — empowering communities, enabling commerce, and reflecting the ambition of a rising nation.
